notes.subject: mafolofolo a madirelo
notes.rationale: מעמקים ke bontši bja 'folofolo ya lefase' — go tšwa mafolofolong, se sengwe le se sengwe se ka se swarwe kgafuri

notes.subject: Pina ya maetakong
notes.rationale: המעלות: 'ya go nyakoretša' (dikoere tše lesome hlano tša go ya Yerushalayime) kgahlanong le 'ya maetakong/mabohloko' — both plural-of-ascent readings

notes.subject: to Yahwe
notes.rationale: mokoledi o bitša Leina ka boomo

translation: Pina ya maetakong. Go tšwa mafolofolong a madirelo gwa go bitša wena, o Yahwe.
